name: word
description: Read, edit and create Word .docx files - including Word tracked changes, native styles and filling out templates.

author.title: Tracked-change author
author.description: Optional. Name stamped on Word tracked changes, e.g. your own name. Every folder and the Python interpreter come from the suite-wide EVA_PYTHON, EVA_DOCUMENTS_DIR, EVA_TEMPLATES_DIR and EVA_KNOWLEDGE_DIR environment variables - this server uses the 'word' sub-folder of each. All three folders must exist; see the plugin README.
